changes.description: Matplotlib 3.1 has no TwoSlopeNorm. Wrapper uses Normalize with symmetric endpoints, preserving a zero-centered scale.
Correct -> unresolved replaces Correct -> wrong because one of six harmful review changes is abstention. Values and examples unchanged.
Recomputed CSV tables compare through universal-newline text because Git normalizes CRLF to LF. Every value and column remains exactly compared.
Removed optional reference balancing that caused a 1.2-point vertical overflow. Condensed main sections and retained detailed results in supplement.
